convergence.comparison: pixelmatch threshold 0.1, per-state budget 1.0% (dispatch default; states.json pixelThreshold 0.03 is the Gate-1 story budget, not this loop's). Targets = NORMALIZED v001 prototype, per-state roots/steps/viewports from states.json, headless Chromium 151.0.7922.34 (playwright 1.62.1), deviceScaleFactor 2, fonts.googleapis/gstatic blocked with Heebo + Noto Serif served from pencil/designs/fonts TTFs (the same files the .pen references) over CORS-enabled localhost. Element capture uses an INTERIOR clip (ceil origin / floor size). Every state self-consistency-gated: three FULL RELOADS (steps re-driven) byte-identical, 12/12. ENVIRONMENT-FACT CORRECTION (supersedes the GC-003 v002 Linux flag list for capture targets): --disable-font-subpixel-positioning AND --font-render-hinting=none both change text LAYOUT on Linux (glyph advances), shifting intrinsic column widths off the oracle's banked vectors (probed: topic 116.08 with either flag vs the contract's 117.6 without). Targets rendered with only --disable-lcd-text --force-color-profile=srgb --disable-partial-raster --disable-skia-runtime-opts --num-raster-threads=1 --disable-gpu; byte-determinism re-verified without the two dropped flags.
convergence.iterationNotes: Six compare rounds ran; two were tooling-defect re-runs that consumed no budget (a Range/probe DOM bug that corrupted the config-error line split, and a re-run after a mis-composed adjustment file). The five honest rounds: (1) initial extraction-driven authoring (paint-ordered draw list from computed styles; per-line text via Range rects + zero-size inline-block baseline probe; two-rect border model; wrap as clip frame; sticky cells layered above scrolled content; calibrated pen baseline model A(family,size,weight,lineHeight) from an 'H' ink-bottom probe export): 2/4 within budget, config-error 6.4% (wrapped-line baseline defect). (2) word-level x pinning (pen advances drift vs Chromium along long runs) + per-class ink-delta shift refinement measured export-vs-target: 2/4, config-error 2.3%. (3) per-state-class shift refinement + device-aligned per-instance checkbox raster crops + per-CHARACTER x pinning for weight-500 runs (pen's 500-instance advances measure wider than Chromium's): 3/4 pass, config-error 2.1%. (4) root-cause fix: Chromium SNAPS each rendered text baseline to integer css px (config-error layout pitch 20.297px but rendered ink pitch 21px) while pen renders continuously (probed: pen ink moves 0.5 device px per 0.25 css offset, x and y) - baselines rounded before conversion, per-state residuals re-derived cleanly (config-error text 183/183 chars at (0,0)): 3/4, config-error 1.5% with ALL residual in the border rows. (5) Chromium pixel-snaps the error panel's border box so the snapped top/bottom border rows fall OUTSIDE the interior clip (measured: interior rows 0 and 129 pure wash); ring re-modeled 1 css px beyond the clip vertically: 4/4 converged, worst 0.382%, best 0.003%. Residual is cross-rasterizer text AA.
